object.description: After the fresh install, list %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Mellon, start mellon.exe from it, and run 'mellon-mcp.exe --version' from it in a terminal. Expected: mellon.exe and mellon-mcp.exe are directly in the install folder; mellon.exe opens the Project Explorer; mellon-mcp.exe prints the release number and exits with status 0.
